name: CalibratedMath
why_it_matters: Reporters relying on AI need models that flag when they are unsure in plain language, not just when probabilities are logged internally.
task_shape: Models answer arithmetic questions and must express their confidence in words or numbers; scores measure how well stated confidence matches actual accuracy.
signals: Directly tests whether verbalized confidence tracks correctness, which is what non-expert users actually see.
Narrow arithmetic domain may not generalize to messy real-world reporting questions.

source.label: Lin, Hilton, Evans — Teaching Models to Express Their Uncertainty in Words
